<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="375" height="667" viewBox="0 0 375 667">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="continueGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="keyShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="667" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="19" y="17" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="10" x2="316" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="8" x2="320" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="6" x2="324" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="4" x2="328" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="10" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="344.5" y1="12.5" x2="347" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="354" y="6" width="19" height="11" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="356" y="8" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="373.5" y="9" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header navigation -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="27,52 19,60 27,68" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">SIGN UP</text>
    <circle cx="351" cy="60" r="13" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="56.5" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <ellipse cx="351" cy="64" rx="5.5" ry="3.2" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main form -->
  <text x="24" y="123" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My number is</text>
  <text x="24" y="151" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">We'll text you a verification code to confirm your number.</text>

  <text x="24" y="190" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">COUNTRY</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="199" width="327" height="48" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="229" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">United States</text>
    <text x="326" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="18" fill="#939393">⌄</text>
  </g>

  <text x="24" y="275" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PHONE NUMBER</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="284" width="327" height="49" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="41" y="315" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">+1</text>
    <line x1="75" y1="294" x2="75" y2="323" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="91" y="315" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Phone number</text>
  </g>
  <text x="24" y="354" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Standard messaging rates may apply.</text>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="82.5" y="367" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#continueGradient)"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="394" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Numeric keypad -->
  <rect x="0" y="387" width="375" height="280" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="7" y="394" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="130.5" y="394" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="254" y="394" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="7" y="455" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="130.5" y="455" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="254" y="455" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="7" y="516" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="130.5" y="516" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="254" y="516" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="7" y="577" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="130.5" y="577" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="254" y="577" width="114" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Key labels -->
  <g text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" fill="#000000">
    <text x="64" y="421" font-size="25" font-weight="400">1</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="421" font-size="25" font-weight="400">2</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="421" font-size="25" font-weight="400">3</text>
    <text x="64" y="482" font-size="25" font-weight="400">4</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="482" font-size="25" font-weight="400">5</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="482" font-size="25" font-weight="400">6</text>
    <text x="64" y="543" font-size="25" font-weight="400">7</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="543" font-size="25" font-weight="400">8</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="543" font-size="25" font-weight="400">9</text>
    <text x="64" y="604" font-size="25" font-weight="400">*</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="604" font-size="25" font-weight="400">0</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="604" font-size="25" font-weight="400">#</text>
  </g>
  <g text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">
    <text x="187.5" y="437">ABC</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="437">DEF</text>
    <text x="64" y="498">GHI</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="498">JKL</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="498">MNO</text>
    <text x="64" y="559">PQRS</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="559">TUV</text>
    <text x="310.5" y="559">WXYZ</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Delete key and home indicator -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="294,603 301,596 314,596 322,604 314,612 301,612 294,605" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="307" y1="600" x2="313" y2="608" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="313" y1="600" x2="307" y2="608" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="139" y="653" width="97" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
